1.english_reference: And these [ are the countries ] which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֛לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נָחֲל֥וּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן
traditions.LXX: Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ κατακληρονομήσαντες υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῇ γῇ Χανάαν ,
traditions.VUL: Hoc est quod possedérunt fílii Israel in terra Chánaan ,
traditions.KJV: And these [ are the countries ] which the children of Israel inherited in the land of Canaan ,

1.english_reference: which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed for inheritance to them

traditions.WLC: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִֽחֲל֜וּ אוֹתָ֗ ם אֶלְעָזָ֤ר הַ כֹּהֵן֙ וִ יהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן נ֔וּן וְ רָאשֵׁ֛י אֲב֥וֹת הַ מַּטּ֖וֹת לִ בְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: οἷς κατεκληρονόμησεν αὐτοῖς Ἐλεαζὰρ ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ Ἰησοῦς ὁ τοῦ Ναυὴ καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες πατριῶν φυλῶν τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ .
traditions.VUL: quam dedérunt eis Eleázar sacérdos , et Iósue fílius Nun , et príncipes familiárum per tribus Israel :
traditions.KJV: which Eleazar the priest , and Joshua the son of Nun , and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel , distributed for inheritance to them .

traditions.WLC: בְּ גוֹרַ֖ל נַחֲלָתָ֑ ם
traditions.LXX: κατὰ κλήρους ἐκληρονόμησαν ,
traditions.VUL: sorte ómnia dividéntes ,
traditions.KJV: By lot [ was ] their inheritance ,

2.english_reference: as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ בְּ יַד מֹשֶׁ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο Κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Ἰησοῦ
traditions.VUL: sicut præcéperat Dóminus in manu Móysi ,
traditions.KJV: as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses ,

2.english_reference: for the nine tribes , and [ for ] the half tribe

traditions.WLC: לְ תִשְׁעַ֥ת הַ מַּטּ֖וֹת וַ חֲצִ֥י הַ מַּטֶּֽה
traditions.LXX: ταῖς ἐννέα φυλαῖς καὶ τῷ ἡμίσει φυλῆς ,
traditions.VUL: novem tríbubus , et dimídiæ tríbui .
traditions.KJV: for the nine tribes , and [ for ] the half tribe .

3.english_reference: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי נָתַ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה נַחֲלַ֨ת שְׁנֵ֤י הַ מַּטּוֹת֙ וַ חֲצִ֣י הַ מַּטֶּ֔ה מֵ עֵ֖בֶר לַ יַּרְדֵּ֑ן
traditions.LXX: ἀπὸ τοῦ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου .
traditions.VUL: Duábus enim tríbubus , et dimídiæ , déderat Móyses trans Iordánem possessiónem :
traditions.KJV: For Moses had given the inheritance of two tribes and an half tribe on the other side Jordan :

3.english_reference: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them

traditions.WLC: וְ לַ֨ לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּ תוֹכָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς Λευείταις οὐκ ἔδωκεν κλῆρον ἐν αὐτοῖς ,
traditions.VUL: absque Levítis , qui nihil terræ accepérunt inter fratres suos :
traditions.KJV: but unto the Levites he gave none inheritance among them .

4.english_reference: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim

traditions.WLC: כִּֽי הָי֧וּ בְנֵֽי יוֹסֵ֛ף שְׁנֵ֥י מַטּ֖וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֣ה וְ אֶפְרָ֑יִם
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἦσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰωσὴφ δύο φυλαὶ Μανασσὴ καὶ Ἐφράιμ ·
traditions.VUL: sed in eórum successérunt locum fílii Ioseph in duas divísi tribus , Manásse et Ephraim :
traditions.KJV: For the children of Joseph were two tribes , Manasseh and Ephraim :

4.english_reference: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא נָתְנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק לַ לְוִיִּ֜ם בָּ אָ֗רֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὐκ ἐδόθη μερὶς ἐν τῇ γῇ τοῖς Λευείταις ,
traditions.VUL: nec accepérunt Levítæ áliam in terra partem ,
traditions.KJV: therefore they gave no part unto the Levites in the land ,

4.english_reference: save cities to dwell [ in ] , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י אִם עָרִים֙ לָ שֶׁ֔בֶת וּ מִ֨גְרְשֵׁי הֶ֔ם לְ מִקְנֵי הֶ֖ם וּ לְ קִנְיָנָֽ ם
traditions.LXX: ἀλλ᾽ ἤ πόλεις κατοικεῖν καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῶν τοῖς κτήνεσιν καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: nisi urbes ad habitándum , et suburbána eárum ad alénda iuménta et pécora sua .
traditions.KJV: save cities to dwell [ in ] , with their suburbs for their cattle and for their substance .

5.english_reference: As the LORD commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת מֹשֶׁ֔ה כֵּ֥ן עָשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: ὅν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ , οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: Sicut præcéperat Dóminus Móysi , ita fecérunt fílii Israel ,
traditions.KJV: As the LORD commanded Moses , so the children of Israel did ,

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יַּחְלְק֖וּ אֶת הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐμέρισαν τὴν γῆν .
traditions.VUL: et divisérunt terram .
traditions.KJV: and they divided the land .

6.english_reference: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֤ה אֶל יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ֙ בַּ גִּלְגָּ֔ל
traditions.LXX: Καὶ προσήλθοσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰούδα πρὸς Ἰησοῦν ἐν Γαλγάλ ,
traditions.VUL: Accessérunt ítaque fílii Iuda ad Iósue in Gálgala ,
traditions.KJV: Then the children of Judah came unto Joshua in Gilgal :

6.english_reference: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֔י ו כָּלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה הַ קְּנִזִּ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτὸν Χαλὲβ ὁ τοῦ Ἰεφοννὴ ὁ Κενεζαῖος
traditions.VUL: locutúsque est ad eum Caleb fílius Iéphone Cenezǽus :
traditions.KJV: and Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite said unto him ,

6.english_reference: Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea

traditions.WLC: אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֡עְתָּ אֶֽת הַ דָּבָר֩ אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֣ה אִישׁ הָ אֱלֹהִ֗ים עַ֧ל אֹדוֹתַ֛ י וְ עַ֥ל אֹדוֹתֶ֖י ךָ בְּ קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ
traditions.LXX: Σὺ ἐπίστῃ τὸ ῥῆμα ὅ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν ἄνθρωπον τοῦ θεοῦ περὶ ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ ἐν Καδὴς Βαρνή .
traditions.VUL: Nosti quid locútus sit Dóminus ad Móysen hóminem Dei de me et te in Cadesbárne .
traditions.KJV: Thou knowest the thing that the LORD said unto Moses the man of God concerning me and thee in Kadeshbarnea .

7.english_reference: Forty years old [ was ] I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land

traditions.WLC: בֶּן אַרְבָּעִ֨ים שָׁנָ֜ה אָנֹכִ֗י בִּ֠ שְׁלֹחַ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד יְהוָ֥ה אֹתִ֛ י מִ קָּדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵ֖עַ לְ רַגֵּ֣ל אֶת הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.LXX: τεσσεράκοντα γὰρ ἐτῶν ἤμην ὅτε ἀπέστειλέν με Μωυσῆς ὁ παῖς τοῦ θεοῦ ἐκ Καδὴς Βαρνὴ κατασκοπεῦσαι τὴν γῆν ,
traditions.VUL: Quadragínta annórum eram quando misit me Móyses fámulus Dómini de Cadesbárne , ut considerárem terram ,
traditions.KJV: Forty years old [ was ] I when Moses the servant of the LORD sent me from Kadeshbarnea to espy out the land ;

7.english_reference: and I brought him word again as [ it was ] in mine heart

traditions.WLC: וָ אָשֵׁ֤ב אֹת וֹ֙ דָּבָ֔ר כַּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר עִם לְבָבִֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀπεκρίθην αὐτῷ λόγον κατὰ τὸν νοῦν αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: nuntiavíque ei quod mihi verum videbátur .
traditions.KJV: and I brought him word again as [ it was ] in mine heart .

8.english_reference: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt

traditions.WLC: וְ אַחַ י֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָל֣וּ עִמִּ֔ י הִמְסִ֖יו אֶת לֵ֣ב הָ עָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: οἱ δὲ ἀδελφοί μου οἱ ἀναβάντες μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ μετέστησαν τὴν καρδίαν τοῦ λαοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: Fratres autem mei , qui ascénderant mecum , dissolvérunt cor pópuli :
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless my brethren that went up with me made the heart of the people melt :

8.english_reference: but I wholly followed the LORD my God

traditions.WLC: וְ אָנֹכִ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתִי אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ י
traditions.LXX: ἐγὼ δὲ προσέθην ἐπακολουθῆσαι Κυρίῳ τῷ θεῷ μου .
traditions.VUL: et nihilóminus ego secútus sum Dóminum Deum meum .
traditions.KJV: but I wholly followed the LORD my God .

9.english_reference: And Moses sware on that day , saying

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשָּׁבַ֣ע מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ הוּא֮ לֵ אמֹר֒
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὤμοσεν Μωυσῆς ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ λέγων
traditions.VUL: Iuravítque Móyses in die illo , dicens :
traditions.KJV: And Moses sware on that day , saying ,

9.english_reference: Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children ’s for ever

traditions.WLC: אִם לֹ֗א הָ אָ֨רֶץ֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דָּרְכָ֤ה רַגְלְ ךָ֙ בָּ֔ הּ לְ ךָ֨ תִֽהְיֶ֧ה לְ נַחֲלָ֛ה וּ לְ בָנֶ֖י ךָ עַד עוֹלָ֑ם
traditions.LXX: Ἡ γῆ ἐφ᾽ ἣν ἐπέβης σοὶ ἔσται ἐν κλήρῳ καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις σου εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ,
traditions.VUL: Terra , quam calcávit pes tuus , erit posséssio tua , et filiórum tuórum in ætérnum :
traditions.KJV: Surely the land whereon thy feet have trodden shall be thine inheritance , and thy children ’s for ever ,

9.english_reference: because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י מִלֵּ֔אתָ אַחֲרֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽ י
traditions.LXX: ὅτι προσετέθης ἐπακολουθῆσαι ὀπίσω Κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν .
traditions.VUL: quia secútus es Dóminum Deum meum .
traditions.KJV: because thou hast wholly followed the LORD my God .

10.english_reference: And now , behold , the LORD hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה הִנֵּה֩ הֶחֱיָ֨ה יְהוָ֣ה אוֹתִ י֮ כַּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֵּר֒ זֶה֩ אַרְבָּעִ֨ים וְ חָמֵ֜שׁ שָׁנָ֗ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν διέθρεψέν με Κύριος ὃν τρόπον εἶπεν τοῦτο τεσσερακοστὸν καὶ πέμπτον ἔτος
traditions.VUL: Concéssit ergo Dóminus vitam mihi , sicut pollícitus est , usque in præséntem diem . Quadragínta et quinque anni sunt ,
traditions.KJV: And now , behold , the LORD hath kept me alive , as he said , these forty and five years ,

10.english_reference: even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses , while [ the children of ] Israel wandered in the wilderness

traditions.WLC: מֵ֠ אָז דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֶת הַ דָּבָ֤ר הַ זֶּה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר הָלַ֥ךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ מִּדְבָּ֑ר
traditions.LXX: ἀφ᾽ οὗ ἐλάλησεν Κύριος τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο πρὸς Μωυσῆν , καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ .
traditions.VUL: ex quo locútus est Dóminus verbum istud ad Móysen , quando ambulábat Israel per solitúdinem :
traditions.KJV: even since the LORD spake this word unto Moses , while [ the children of ] Israel wandered in the wilderness :

10.english_reference: and now , lo , I [ am ] this day fourscore and five years old

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּה֙ הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֣י הַ יּ֔וֹם בֶּן חָמֵ֥שׁ וּ שְׁמוֹנִ֖ים שָׁנָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ σήμερον ὀγδοήκοντα καὶ πέντε ἐτῶν ·
traditions.VUL: hódie octogínta quinque annórum sum ,
traditions.KJV: and now , lo , I [ am ] this day fourscore and five years old .

11.english_reference: As yet I [ am as ] strong this day as [ I was ] in the day that Moses sent me

traditions.WLC: עוֹדֶ֨ נִּי הַ יּ֜וֹם חָזָ֗ק כַּֽ אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּ י֨וֹם שְׁלֹ֤חַ אוֹתִ י֙ מֹשֶׁ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ἔτι εἰμὶ σήμερον ἰσχύων ὡσεὶ ὅτε ἀπέστειλέν με Μωυσῆς ,
traditions.VUL: sic valens ut eo valébam témpore quando ad explorándum missus sum :
traditions.KJV: As yet I [ am as ] strong this day as [ I was ] in the day that Moses sent me :

11.english_reference: as my strength [ was ] then , even so [ is ] my strength now

traditions.WLC: כְּ כֹ֥חִ י אָ֖ז וּ כְ כֹ֣חִ י עָ֑תָּה
traditions.LXX: ὡσαύτως ἰσχύω νῦν
traditions.VUL: illíus in me témporis fortitúdo usque hódie persevérat ,
traditions.KJV: as my strength [ was ] then , even so [ is ] my strength now ,

11.english_reference: for war , both to go out , and to come in

traditions.WLC: לַ מִּלְחָמָ֖ה וְ לָ צֵ֥את וְ לָ בֽוֹא
traditions.LXX: εἰσελθεῖν καὶ ἐξελθεῖν εἰς τὸν πόλεμον .
traditions.VUL: tam ad bellándum quam ad gradiéndum .
traditions.KJV: for war , both to go out , and to come in .

12.english_reference: Now therefore give me this mountain , whereof the LORD spake in that day

traditions.WLC: וְ עַתָּ֗ה תְּנָ ה לִּ י֙ אֶת הָ הָ֣ר הַ זֶּ֔ה אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בַּ יּ֣וֹם הַ ה֑וּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ νῦν αἰτοῦμαί σε τὸ ὄρος τοῦτο , καθὰ εἶπεν Κύριος τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ·
traditions.VUL: Da ergo mihi montem istum , quem pollícitus est Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: Now therefore give me this mountain , whereof the LORD spake in that day ;

12.english_reference: for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims [ were ] there , and [ that ] the cities [ were ] great [ and ] fenced

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י אַתָּֽה שָׁמַעְתָּ֩ בַ יּ֨וֹם הַ ה֜וּא כִּֽי עֲנָקִ֣ים שָׁ֗ם וְ עָרִים֙ גְּדֹל֣וֹת בְּצֻר֔וֹת
traditions.LXX: ὅτι σὺ ἀκήκοας τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ . νυνὶ δὲ οἱ Ἐνακεὶμ ἐκεῖ εἰσιν , πόλεις ὀχυραὶ καὶ μεγάλαι ·
traditions.VUL: te quoque audiénte , in quo Enacim sunt , et urbes magnæ atque munítæ :
traditions.KJV: for thou heardest in that day how the Anakims [ were ] there , and [ that ] the cities [ were ] great [ and ] fenced :

12.english_reference: if so be the LORD [ will be ] with me , then I shall be able to drive them out , as the LORD said

traditions.WLC: אוּלַ֨י יְהוָ֤ה אוֹתִ י֙ וְ ה֣וֹרַשְׁתִּ֔י ם כַּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָֽה
traditions.LXX: ἐὰν οὖν Κύριος μετ᾽ ἐμοῦ ᾖ , ἐξολεθρεύσω αὐτοὺς ὃν τρόπον εἶπέν μοι Κύριος .
traditions.VUL: si forte sit Dóminus mecum , et potúero delére eos , sicut promísit mihi .
traditions.KJV: if so be the LORD [ will be ] with me , then I shall be able to drive them out , as the LORD said .

traditions.WLC: וַֽ יְבָרְכֵ֖ הוּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦς ,
traditions.VUL: Benedixítque ei Iósue ,
traditions.KJV: And Joshua blessed him ,

13.english_reference: and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּתֵּ֧ן אֶת חֶבְר֛וֹן לְ כָלֵ֥ב בֶּן יְפֻנֶּ֖ה לְ נַחֲלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔδωκεν Χεβρὼν τῷ Χαλὲβ υἱῷ Ἰεφοννὴ υἱῷ Κενὲζ ἐν κλήρῳ .
traditions.VUL: et trádidit ei Hebron in possessiónem .
traditions.KJV: and gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance .

14.english_reference: Hebron therefore became the inheritance of Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite unto this day
